Dalotuzumab is identified as a target of the Liver X receptor (LXR alpha and LXR beta), which in turn is targeted by 5-Alpha-Androstane-3-beta,17beta-Diol and Umbelliferone. Both of these compounds are predicted to interact with UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B4, indicating that Dalotuzumab may influence this enzyme through its interaction with the LXRs. The scores from the two paths, while not identical, both point to a significant relationship, suggesting that Dalotuzumab could modulate UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B4 via the LXRs. The evidence supports a mechanistic link, but the exact nature of the interaction remains uncertain, as the pathways are not fully elucidated. The integration of these findings highlights the role of LXRs in mediating the effects of these compounds on UDP-glucuronosyltransferase 2B4.
